title: 2 Things You Didn't Know About the Lamborghini Urus
description:
The Lamborghini Urus that you can buy is not the car Lamborghini showed in twenty twelve. The concept had a ten-cylinder engine borrowed from the Gallardo. The production car has a twin-turbo V eight that starts life as an Audi engine, built in a factory in Hungary, and sits on the same platform as a Porsche, a Bentley and a Volkswagen. There are two things about the Urus that you probably did not know, and both are in published sources. The first is about the car that was shown at the Beijing Auto Show, and what happened to it. The second is about everything hidden under the Urus's skin, and why Lamborghini's own boss says it is still a real Lamborghini. Every fact in this video comes from published sources, listed in the description. Where sources disagree, we will tell you.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
